name: Electric Bicycle
description: A bicycle or tricycle with fully operable pedals and an electric motor of less than 750 watts, in one of three classes: Class 1 pedal assist to 20 mph, Class 2 throttle to 20 mph, and Class 3 pedal assist to 28 mph.

restrictions.rule: Class 1 and Class 3 assist only while the rider pedals, cutting out at 20 and 28 mph; Class 2 may be propelled by the motor alone, to 20 mph (Arizona Revised Statutes §28-101)
May have two or three wheels (Arizona Revised Statutes §28-101)
Carries a permanent label, in at least 9-point type, stating its class, top assisted speed and motor wattage (Arizona Revised Statutes §28-819)
Has the rights and duties of a bicycle, except where a local authority regulates it otherwise (Arizona Revised Statutes §28-819)
Not a vehicle or motor vehicle under Arizona law, and excluded from the moped, motorcycle and motor driven cycle definitions (Arizona Revised Statutes §28-101)
No title, registration, vehicle license tax, driver's license or insurance (Arizona Revised Statutes §28-819)
No statewide minimum age or helmet requirement; cities may set their own
Class 1 and Class 2 may ride bicycle and multi-use paths, but the local authority or state agency over a path may ban them (Arizona Revised Statutes §28-819)
Class 3 is kept off bicycle and multi-use paths unless the path runs within or beside a road or the agency over it allows it (Arizona Revised Statutes §28-819)
